commit.message:
Test BLAKE3-Servil safety-source key-prefix work independence (#312)

Port the reviewed ordinary cohort/prefix/allocation controls to this exact safety source. Reuse RAN_ENTRIES for kernel-entry sets; trace cohorts only under cfg(test). Production hashing is unchanged, so a speed check would measure the same code and is skipped. Rejecting controls and native x86 validation are recorded separately before owner review. No instruction-level constant-time proof is claimed.
